definitions.explanation: Describing a space that feels pleasantly large and open. Conveys a sense of openness and freedom, often with a positive nuance.

examples.japanese: {広々|ひろびろ}とした{部屋|へや}に{住|す}みたい。
examples.english: I want to live in a spacious room.

examples.japanese: {広々|ひろびろ}とした{草原|そうげん}が{目|め}の{前|まえ}に{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: A vast grassland stretches out before my eyes.

examples.japanese: リフォームして{広々|ひろびろ}とした{空間|くうかん}になった。
examples.english: After the renovation, it became a spacious area.

notes:
A reduplication of {広|ひろ}い (wide) with the と particle, forming an adjectival expression. The reduplication intensifies the sense of spaciousness and adds an emotional, descriptive quality.

FORMS:
- {広々|ひろびろ}とした + noun: modifying a noun (spacious ~)
- {広々|ひろびろ}としている: predicate form (is spacious)
- {広々|ひろびろ}と: adverbial form ({広々|ひろびろ}と{広|ひろ}がる: to spread out spaciously)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {広々|ひろびろ}とした{部屋|へや}: spacious room
- {広々|ひろびろ}とした{空間|くうかん}: expansive space
- {広々|ひろびろ}とした{景色|けしき}: wide-open scenery
- {広々|ひろびろ}とした{公園|こうえん}: spacious park

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {広|ひろ}い: wide, spacious — the base adjective, more neutral
- のびのび: freely, unrestricted — similar positive nuance but focuses on feeling
- ゆったり: roomy, relaxed — emphasizes comfort and ease
